records.extractor_notes: Existing M05 seed presumes rheumatoid factor. FY2026 RA coding spans M05/M06 with serostatus, organ involvement, and site axes. These two broad leaves are not a substitute for the full family; coding review must choose from documentation.
records.mapping_review_note: Generic RA anchor strategy: M06.9 (RA unspecified) is the serostatus-agnostic default candidate; M05.* only with documented rheumatoid factor. Full M05/M06 family selection is documentation-driven.

review.review_method: independent verification against official CDC NCHS FY2026 files (icd10cm-codes-2026.txt · icd10cm-order-2026.txt · icd10cm-index-2026.xml) — every staged code checked for existence, billable status, and exact long description; DRG-page citations cross-checked; red-flag quotes fragment-matched on source pages. 586 codes: 0 nonexistent, 0 billable errors, 78 descriptions aligned to official text, 1 status corrected via official index (plantar fasciitis).
